response_text: {"falsification_test": "Walk-forward test with the parameters fixed in advance, using realistic taker fees plus slippage (at least 6 bps per side). The hypothesis is rejected if any of these happen: (1) the pooled net Sharpe on the out-of-sample folds is \u2264 0.5, or its bootstrap 95% CI includes 0; (2) the efficiency-gated version fails to beat the ungated version's net Sharpe by at least 0.2 out of sample; (3) more than half of the out-of-sample folds have negative net returns, which would mean the edge is still regime-dependent; (4) cost drag uses up more than 50% of the gross return.", "family": "trend", "prior": 0.3, "required_data": ["klines", "mark"], "required_features": ["return_20d", "ema_50_200_crossover", "kaufman_efficiency_ratio_20d", "efficiency_ratio_rolling_percentile_60", "realized_vol_20d", "mark_kline_basis_check", "turnover_with_no_trade_band"], "statement": "Across the 8-asset universe, a slow time-series trend signal (sign of the 20-day return combined with the 50/200 hourly-bar EMA crossover, held on a daily rebalance) earns a positive net-of-cost return. The efficiency gate is meant to deal with the regime-dependence seen in earlier trend tests. The low turnover (daily rebalance plus a no-trade band of \u00b10.25 signal units) is meant to deal with cost erosion. The strategy uses only klines and mark prices, so it does not need any missing data."}

{"falsification_test": "Walk-forward test with a 2-year in-sample window and 6-month out-of-sample windows, using equal risk across the 8 assets. Reject the hypothesis if any of these hold: (a) pooled out-of-sample Sharpe net of 10 bps per side costs is 0.3 or lower; (b) the filtered version does not beat the unfiltered EMA crossover on net Sharpe in at least 60% of out-of-sample windows; (c) more than half of the net PnL comes from a single asset or a single 6-month window; (d) the result loses its sign under \u00b130% changes to the parameters (EMA lengths, 0.5 threshold, ER window).", "family": "trend", "prior": 0.3, "required_data": ["klines"], "required_features": ["ema_50_close", "ema_200_close", "realized_vol_60d", "efficiency_ratio_20d", "efficiency_ratio_rolling_median_365d", "daily_returns"], "statement": "Across S01-S08, a slow time-series trend signal (sign of the 50-day minus 200-day EMA spread of daily close, divided by 60-day realized volatility) only enters a position when the absolute spread exceeds 0.5 vol units and the 20-day efficiency ratio is above its own 1-year median. {"falsification_test": "Split the data by time into walk-forward folds. Thresholds are fixed in advance (z\u22652.0, volume filter 2x), with no tuning on the test folds. This tests whether the filter adds anything: if events with volume spikes revert just as much, the conditioning claim is false; (d) net Sharpe after costs falls below 0.5 when costs are doubled to 50 bps round-trip.
